segments.text:
V. 27.
His diſciples marvelled that he talked with a woman—Which the Jewiſh Rabbis reckoned ſcandalous for a Man of Diſtinction to do. They marvelled likewiſe at his talking with a Woman of that Nation, which was ſo peculiarly hateful to the Jews. Yet none ſaid—To the Woman. What ſeekeſt thou? Or to Chriſt, Why talkeſt thou with her?
